text: A股PCB（印制电路板）板块迎来密集业绩预告披露期。Wind数据显示，截至10月12日，共有6家PCB产业链上市公司先后发布2026年前三季度或第三季度业绩预告，记者梳理发现，上述公司今年前三季度归母净利润均预计实现较大幅度的同比增长。（证券日报）
text_en: The A-share PCB (printed circuit board) sector has entered a period of intensive earnings forecast disclosures. Wind data shows that as of October 12, a total of 6 listed companies in the PCB industrial chain had successively released earnings forecasts for the first three quarters or third quarter of 2026. A review by the reporter found that all of the above companies are expected to achieve relatively large year-on-year increases in net profit attributable to parent companies for the first three quarters of this year. (Securities Daily)
